tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: Use this first whenever someone asks for chess websites, sites or apps for a need (including free, no sign-up, a variant or a device), e.g. "play chess960 with friends", "puzzle trainer for beginners", "analyse my games with an engine", "chess club software". Returns ranked sites with a one-line sum

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Use this only for ONE named chess site or app (for two or more sites, or X vs Y, use compare_sites); pass its slug, name or domain, e.g. "lichess", "chess.com", "Chessable"): summary, price model, platforms, levels, languages, features, status and the guides that feature it. Do not use to analyse po

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Use this whenever someone says compare, versus, vs, difference between or which is better about 2 to 5 named chess sites: side by side on price, platforms, levels, languages and topics, with the guides that cover all of them. Example: ["chess.com", "lichess"]. Do not use for rating or engine compari

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Use this only when someone wants to browse guides, not to find sites (use search_sites for that): the directory's published guides (chess960, chess for kids, electronic chess boards, chess sets, chess clocks, play against the computer, chess.com alternatives), each with its one-paragraph answer. Pas

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Use this only after list_guides, or when the person names a guide; for a list of sites use search_sites. Returns one guide in full, with picks by need, prices with the date each was read for products, the sites or products it compares, and its common questions. Pass a guide slug from list_guides, e.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Use this when someone shops for physical chess things: sets, boards, pieces, clocks, tables and electronic boards from the directory's buying guides, with price, the date the price was read, seller, specs and who each suits. Example: query "wooden set", max_price 150. Do not use for software, course
